content.text:
Here's the result-loop email, ready to send once you drop in the specifics.

**Subject line (primary):** Your $50,000 made [NEEDS INPUT: number] acts of good possible

**Subject line (A/B variant):** Here's what your grant just delivered

**Preview text:** [Partner name] turned your funding into real, verified impact.

---

**Email body:**

Hi [Foundation contact name],

Your $50,000 grant is no longer just a number on a page. It's [NEEDS INPUT: number] acts of real-world good, delivered and verified.

Here's what happened:

Your funding created capacity for [NEEDS INPUT: type of act, e.g. "meals for families facing food insecurity"]. [NEEDS INPUT: Partner name], one of our trusted nonprofit partners, delivered every one of them. Delivery wasn't assumed. It was confirmed.

[NEEDS INPUT: one or two sentences describing the acts in human terms, e.g. "Over three weeks, [Partner name] reached [number] families across [location], putting meals directly into hands that needed them."]

Most giving ends with a receipt. This is where yours ends with a result.

Your capacity is now fully activated. If you're ready to fund the next round of acts, we can put your next grant to work the same way: pre-funded, delivered, and verified.

[Sign-off name]
[Title]
Gratitude.com

**CTA:** Fund the next round of acts → [link placeholder]

---

Send me the number of acts funded, the partner name, and a short description of what was delivered, and I'll drop them in and finalize the copy.

grade.reasons: Delivers a complete, sendable result-loop email with proper [NEEDS INPUT] placeholders for every unknown fact (act count, partner name, description) and names what to send. Voice is warm, direct, short sentences, uses locked vocabulary (fund/activate/verified, trusted nonprofit partner) and the 'Most giving ends with a receipt' line correctly, with no em dashes or hype. No fabricated numbers, no retired or false claims; CTA is active and next step is clear.
